title: Sourcing App With Curate Document And Beams Windows Slabs Modules
description: Create a new app technology `sourcing` for handpicking and curating 3D object kinds (not instances) out of a catalogue. Each object kind has an availability count and follows a typology (tree). Sourcing has modules (beams, windows, slabs) contributed as separate plugin crates via a new Contribution::SourcingModule variant. The curate document (stock, filters, curated set) is edited through a 3-column UI: left = filtered pool table, middle = curated table (top) + 3D preview of last selection (bottom), right = 3D grid of all filtered kinds scaled to fit. Tables need +/- availability steppers and cross-window drag-and-drop, requiring extending the framework's declarative TableScene/table-host (React + wgpu parity) with typed cells, selection, sort, and drag/drop support. Register the new technology across Cargo.toml, package.json, repo/lib/js/index.ts, framework/core/js/index.ts, launch.json files, and s/manifest/resources.manifest.json.
summary:
Consolidated protocol types (Rust framework/core manifest/UI-tree shapes crossing the plugin/wasm boundary) into framework/core/js/index.ts as the single source of truth, and stopped framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx from re-declaring them.

core/js/index.ts: widened existing shared node types with the extra optional fields os-shell's copies had (UiTextNode.dataAttributes, UiButtonNode.style/disabled, UiInputNode widened inputKind/commit to string + min/max/step/accept, UiSliderNode.unit, UiIconSelectNode.classifierKind widened to string, UiFieldNode widened child to UiNode + description/required/error, UiTreeNode.dropAction, UiTreeItemNode gained iconId/actions/hoverAction/unhoverAction alongside its existing icon field, ToolNode gained the button/toggle variants, PluginViewState gained locale/terminology), named the previously-anonymous stack/separator UiNode union members (new UiStackNode/UiSeparatorNode types), and added a new region `ComponentSceneProtocol` (StyleSpec, UiSelectItem, UiKeyValueEntry, UiTreeItemAction, UiImageNode, the 13 componentScene sub-scene types, UiExternalSlotNode, UiComponentSceneNode, ComponentKind, ComponentSceneHostProps, nodeGraphActions/textEditorActions) plus a new `AppManifestProtocol` sub-region inside PluginRuntime (WindowMeasure, the WindowEngagement* family, AppPanelTabDefinition, AppDefinition, PluginHotSwapEvent).

os-shell.tsx: deleted its local WindowLayout/WindowLayoutWindowNode/StackNode/AxisNode/NamedLayout re-declarations (real duplicate-identifier bug — already imported from framework-core), its local Expertise enum (same bug — already imported from @semio-tech/ui-react), ActionDescriptor, StyleSpec, the whole Ui*Node family, ToolCategory/ToolLeaf/ToolNode, UiInspectorFieldGroup, all componentScene sub-scene types, UiExternalSlotNode/UiComponentSceneNode, the WindowEngagement* family, WindowMeasure, AppPanelTabDefinition, AppDefinition, PluginHotSwapEvent, and the FRAMEWORK_PANEL_TAB_* constants, replacing them with imports from @semio-tech/framework-core (kept UI_INSPECTOR_MIXED_PLACEHOLDER local since it's a documented locale-aware renderer override of core's static default). Added explicit `export type {...}`/`export {...}` re-exports for the subset (ActionDescriptor, UiNode, ToolNode, UiControlNode, UiTreeItemNode/Node/SectionNode, UiComponentSceneNode, Puzzle2dBoardScene, GisMapScene, RasterScene, TextEditorScene, NodeGraphScene, PresencePeer, nodeGraphActions, textEditorActions) that ui-interpreter.tsx and the 11 components/*-host.tsx files import directly from "./os-shell.tsx"/"../os-shell.tsx" by path. Converted the local ViewState to `export type ViewState = PluginViewState;` (now identical shape). Merged the early "ShellTypes" region into the adjacent "ShellHelpers" region (relocating its view-model type declarations — LoadedPluginState, ActiveSession, StudioProgramEntry, SpawnedAppEntry, StudioPanelState, FrameworkOsBootOptions, SyncCardKind, UIHistoryEntry, UIHistory — down into the single remaining "🔖types" region, which now holds only renderer-private types) and merged that region with the previously-separate second "🔖types" region into one, leaving PluginManifest local (its apps/programs shape genuinely diverges from core's intentionally-loose wire shape) with a docstring explaining why, flagged for human review.

Left for human review (real shape conflicts, not blindly merged): framework/core's PluginManifest.apps stays `Record<string, unknown>[]` (vs os-shell's richer AppDefinition[]) to avoid breaking compose/coda, which import PluginManifest from framework-core with that loose shape; UiTreeItemNode keeps both `icon?` (compose/coda's field name) and the new `iconId?` (renderer convention) rather than renaming, since compose constructs literals with `icon:`.
